marta: FYI customer 'acme-inc' hit repeated function-calling failures when using our OpenAI-compatible API. They say the model returns a tool invocation with different field names and enum casing and our schema validator rejects it. Repro + logs below, assigning to eng/runtime if needed.

marta: Customer repro (cURL):
```\nPOST /v1/chat/completions
{
  \"model\": \"gpt-xx-compat\",
  \"messages\": [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Call audio.create with voice=soft\"}],
  \"tools\": [{\"name\": \"audio.create\", \"parameters\": {\"voice\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"enum\": [\"soft\", \"loud\"]}}}]
}
```

marta: Model returned (excerpt):
```json
{
  \"tool_call\": {
    \"name\": \"audio.create\",
    \"arguments\": \"{\\\"voice\\\": \\\"soft\\\"}\"
  }
}
```

marta: Our validator expects arguments to be an object (not stringified) and enum values uppercase tokens like \"TONE_SOFT\" or canonical values. The runtime log shows: `tool_invocation.rejected reason=enum_mismatch field=voice value=soft expected=[TONE_SOFT,TONE_LOUD]`

support-bot: Ticket created: INC-12345. Priority: P2. Assigned to eng-runtime. :rotating_light:

ajay: Thanks Marta. Can you paste the full runtime debug for the request id? Need to see whether the compat normalizer ran. Also did customer attach their tool schema in the request or are they relying on our catalog mapping?

marta: request_id=01GWZP-abc123, log snippet: `compat.normalizer: skipped (schema_mismatch=true)`, next: `validator: args_type=string -> reject`. Full snippet: 
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] request_id=01GWZP-abc123 compat.normalizer: found tool audio.create schema_vendor=openai-compat version=2025-11-01
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] compat.normalizer: incoming.arguments.type=string, expected=object, normalizer_skipped=true
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] validator: enum_mismatch field=voice incoming=soft expected=[TONE_SOFT,TONE_LOUD]
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] tool_invocation.rejected request_id=01GWZP-abc123 reason=enum_mismatch
```

leo: I think two problems: (1) arguments are stringified JSON (common with some OpenAI-toolcall variants), (2) enum/casing mismatch. Our normalizer can handle stringified args if enabled, and we have a config toggle to treat enums case-insensitively / alias mapping. Seems the compat layer didn't run normalization because the tool schema the customer provided differs in field name case (they used \"voice\" while our catalog uses \"Tone\"). The normalizer does a best-effort by field name match but it's strict by default.

leo: Proposed fix options:
- Short-term: add a shim in the request gateway to attempt JSON.parse on arguments when args is a string and attempt case-insensitive enum mapping. Low-risk toggle.
- Medium: update compat.normalizer to include alias mapping table for known partner variants (add voice -> Tone mapping and lowercase enum aliasing). Requires tests.
- Long-term: improve tooling docs to encourage canonical schema in tools parameter and add auto-suggest in Console.

marta: Customer asks for a workaround ASAP. Can we do short-term shim and then notify them?

eng-oncall: Short-term shim is doable and low risk if behind a feature flag. I'll volunteer to run the rollout: create feature flag ff.normalizer.lenient_enum_and_parse, enable for Acme's org only. Would like QA smoke window and canary to 5% traffic then on customer.

ajay: Please also add a telemetry tag so we can measure how many requests hit the shim and whether there are any false positives. Tag: compat.shim=v1.

leo: I'll prepare the patch. Basic behavior: if arguments is a string -> try JSON.parse; if parsed successfully, feed into validator; for enum fields, try case-insensitive match and map known lowercase tokens (soft -> TONE_SOFT) using a small alias table. Will add a flag to toggle full aliasing.

marta: I'll message customer to apply a temporary client-side workaround (send arguments as JSON object and use canonical enum values) and to expect a follow-up in ~2 hours.

ajay: tests to add:
- stringified arguments -> parsed and accepted
- lowercase enum -> mapped to canonical
- ambiguous value -> still rejected and returns clear error explaining mapping suggestion

eng-oncall: I'll do canary deploy then escalate to prod upon green. ETA 2 hours.

marta: Customer acknowledged workaround and will try after we flip the flag. :eyes:

leo: Patch submitted: PR #4872, includes feature flag and unit tests.

eng-oncall: Canary ran for 30m (5% traffic) no regressions, turning on for acme-inc org now.

marta: Customer confirmed success — function call accepted and tool executed. Closing loop. Thanks all. :tada:

ajay: Post-mortem action items: add alias mapping doc, add telemetry dashboards for compat.shim, and triage other vendors for similar mismatches.

support-bot: Incident INC-12345 resolved and linked to PR #4872.
